data.title: Unit 8: Matter and changing matter
Matter and particles
data.heading: Freezing
data.text: Freezing a liquid changes its state to solid.
When a substance freezes, its molecules start to lose energy and move closer to each other.
The freezing point of a substance is the same as its melting point in the solid state.
Water in its liquid state will turn to ice if the temperature becomes less than 0˚C.
Ice will turn to water if the temperature is increased above 0˚C.
All liquids have a different freezing point that can be measured by temperature.
